## Block Thomas sweep and back substitution: one serial pass up, one down, per column (`ForwardSweep`) {#sec-ch07-vic-sweep}

### Summary

The right-hand side is the explicit increment of the stage over the step handed to the solve. So the sweep returns
the corrected increment $\boldsymbol\delta = (\mathsf I+\Delta t_c\mathsf M)^{-1}\Delta\mathbf U^{(0)}_{\mathrm{sv}}$, which is the
explicit one, in the solved variables of @sec-ch07-vic-stage, when $\Delta t_c\to0$. For the partial system the
assembly's tangential term is subtracted from the right-hand side first (@eq-ch07-vic-fold). Every block it inverts is first
factored by `ludcmp` with the pivot guard of @sec-ch07-vic-pivot. A refused block marks the whole column as failed.

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**Purpose.** Solves one column's block-tridiagonal system: forward elimination, then back substitution; @eq-ch07-vic-sweep.

**Data.** Reads $\mathsf A_i$, $\mathsf B_i$, $\mathsf C_i$, $\Delta\mathbf U^{(0)}_{\mathrm{sv},i}/\Delta t_c$ and, for $N=3$, the assembly's $\mathbf f^{\mathrm{tan}}_i$; writes $\boldsymbol\delta_i$[^rg-9741895ca2fa], or NaN in a failed column.

**Placement.** Every stage with a VIC, after the assembly.

**Activation.** As for the assembly; $N=3$ or $N=5$.

**Guarantee / limits.** A direct solve, exact up to round-off; no pivoting between blocks.

**Evidence.** @tbl-ch07-vic-sweep-tests; `test_lu_failure.release`, `vic_sweep_check.py` `[C1]`–`[C6]`.
:::

Local symbols: $\mathbf f_i=\Delta\mathbf U^{(0)}_{\mathrm{sv},i}/\Delta t_c$ is the right-hand side of row $i$ for $N=5$, and
$\mathbf f_i=\Delta\mathbf U^{(0)}_{\mathrm{sv},i}/\Delta t_c-\mathbf f^{\mathrm{tan}}_i$ for $N=3$, with $\mathbf f^{\mathrm{tan}}_i$ the
tangential term of @eq-ch07-vic-fold;
$\tilde{\mathsf C}_i$ the reduced upper block and $\tilde{\boldsymbol\delta}_i$ the forward value of row $i$; $\mathsf M$ the column
operator without $\mathsf I/\Delta t_c$ (@sec-ch07-vic-stage); $n_{\mathrm{lay}}$ the number of layers of the column;
$\zeta_n=n(\epsilon_{\mathrm m}/2)/(1-n\epsilon_{\mathrm m}/2)$ bounds the relative error of $n$ roundings. $\boldsymbol\delta_i$
is in the units of $\Delta\mathbf U^{(0)}$ (total-mass basis), and $\mathbf f_i$ in those units per second.

### Derivation

With the right-hand side $\mathbf f_i$ in the solved variables (@sec-ch07-vic-stage), row $i$ reads
$\mathsf B_i\boldsymbol\delta_{i-1}+\mathsf A_i\boldsymbol\delta_i+\mathsf C_i\boldsymbol\delta_{i+1}=\mathbf f_i$. Block elimination without pivoting
between blocks runs in three steps:

1. Suppose the rows above have been reduced to
   $\boldsymbol\delta_{i-1}=\tilde{\boldsymbol\delta}_{i-1}-\tilde{\mathsf C}_{i-1}\boldsymbol\delta_i$.
2. Substituting into row $i$ gives
   $(\mathsf A_i-\mathsf B_i\tilde{\mathsf C}_{i-1})\boldsymbol\delta_i+\mathsf C_i\boldsymbol\delta_{i+1}=\mathbf f_i-\mathsf B_i\tilde{\boldsymbol\delta}_{i-1}$.
3. Hence, for $i=0,1,\ldots,n_{\mathrm{lay}}-1$ with $\tilde{\mathsf C}_{-1}$ and $\tilde{\boldsymbol\delta}_{-1}$ taken as zero,

$$
\begin{aligned}
\tilde{\mathsf C}_i &= \big(\mathsf A_i - \mathsf B_i \tilde{\mathsf C}_{i-1}\big)^{-1} \mathsf C_i , \\
\tilde{\boldsymbol\delta}_i &= \big(\mathsf A_i - \mathsf B_i \tilde{\mathsf C}_{i-1}\big)^{-1}\big(\mathbf f_i - \mathsf B_i\,\tilde{\boldsymbol\delta}_{i-1}\big) ,
\end{aligned}
$$ {#eq-ch07-vic-sweep}

and the back pass is $\boldsymbol\delta_{n_{\mathrm{lay}}-1}=\tilde{\boldsymbol\delta}_{n_{\mathrm{lay}}-1}$,
$\boldsymbol\delta_i=\tilde{\boldsymbol\delta}_i-\tilde{\mathsf C}_i\boldsymbol\delta_{i+1}$ from $i=n_{\mathrm{lay}}-2$ down to 0. The code stores
$\tilde{\mathsf C}_i$ in `a[i]` and overwrites `delta[i]` in place. Steps 1 to 3 are exact in rational arithmetic
(`[C6]`).

4. *What it returns.* The diagonal of $\mathsf A_i$ holds $\mathsf I/\Delta t_c$ and $\mathbf f_i$ divides by the same
   $\Delta t_c$, since the kernel receives `dt_corr` for both (`rhs(1) = DU(IVX + dir, i) / dt` in
   {{< code src/implicit/forward_sweep_impl.h ForwardSweep >}}). Multiplying the system by $\Delta t_c$ gives
   $\boldsymbol\delta=(\mathsf I+\Delta t_c\mathsf M)^{-1}\Delta\mathbf U^{(0)}_{\mathrm{sv}}$, which tends to
   $\Delta\mathbf U^{(0)}_{\mathrm{sv}}$ as $\Delta t_c\to0$ (`[C2]`). For $N=3$ the same holds with $\Delta t_c\mathbf f^{\mathrm{tan}}_i$
   subtracted from $\Delta\mathbf U^{(0)}_{\mathrm{sv},i}$; that term is zero when every $v_a$ and $\tilde m_a$ is. At the second rk3 stage, $\Delta t_c=\Delta t/4$, and the
   result differs from $(\mathsf I+\Delta t\mathsf M)^{-1}\Delta\mathbf U^{(0)}_{\mathrm{sv}}$ by 3.7 relative at $\Delta t=10$ s
   (`[C5]`).
5. *Accuracy.* On 60 layers the two passes match a dense solve within $10^{-11}$ relative for both $N=3$ and $N=5$ (`[C1]`).
6. *Round-off.* Each entry of $\mathsf A_i-\mathsf B_i\tilde{\mathsf C}_{i-1}$ is an $N$-term inner product subtracted from
   an entry, so it is within $\zeta_{N+1}$ of $\lvert\mathsf A_i\rvert+\lvert\mathsf B_i\rvert\lvert\tilde{\mathsf C}_{i-1}\rvert$ entrywise;
   the factorisation of that block adds the $\zeta_N$ backward error of @sec-ch07-vic-pivot. The forward error of
   $\boldsymbol\delta$ is these backward errors times the condition number of the column operator.

The first entry of $\mathbf f_i$ is $\Delta^{\mathrm{stg}}\rho_i/\Delta t_c$, the increment of the total density $\rho$, dry
plus every species that carries mass; it is not the first row $\Delta\mathbf U^{(0)}[\rho_{\mathrm d}]_i$ of the conserved
layout, which is the dry density alone. The species are not in the system; they follow in
@sec-ch07-vic-redistribute.

In the code, @eq-ch07-vic-sweep is `ForwardSweep` ({{< code src/implicit/forward_sweep_impl.h ForwardSweep >}}) followed by `vic_backward_substitute` ({{< code src/implicit/vic_redistribute_impl.h vic_backward_substitute >}}).

### Numerical method

See @fig-ch07-vic-sweep for the two passes.

```{python}
#| label: fig-ch07-vic-sweep
#| fig-cap: "The block-tridiagonal matrix of one column (green: the diagonal blocks $\\mathsf A_i$; sky blue: $\\mathsf B_i$, $\\mathsf C_i$) and the two passes that solve it. The forward sweep (orange) runs from the first row to the last, forms $\\tilde{\\mathsf C}_i$ and $\\tilde{\\boldsymbol\\delta}_i$, and factors each eliminated block with ludcmp, refusing it when a pivot ratio is at most $8N\\epsilon_{\\mathrm{m}}$; the back substitution (blue) runs from the last row to the first."
#| fig-alt: "A six-by-six block-tridiagonal matrix on the left, and on the right a downward orange arrow with the forward formulas and an upward blue arrow with the back-substitution formula."
#| echo: false
from snapy_report.ch07.figures.fig_vic_sweep import make_fig
make_fig()
```

`ForwardSweep` builds the right-hand side `rhs` of each layer from the explicit increment, with the density row
summed over the species ({{< code src/implicit/forward_sweep_impl.h ForwardSweep >}}). For $N=3$, called with `rhs_in_delta`, it
then subtracts the $\mathbf f^{\mathrm{tan}}_i$ the assembly left in `delta[i]`, through `correct`, before `delta[i]` is
overwritten; an exact zero entry is skipped, so a wind-free column's `rhs` is unchanged bit for bit. `vic_solve_cpu`
passes `rhs_in_delta` as `N == 3` ({{< code src/implicit/implicit_dispatch.cpp vic_solve_cpu >}}). For $N=5$ it factors the eliminated block and
solves for $\tilde{\mathsf C}_i$ and $\tilde{\boldsymbol\delta}_i$ together with the multi-column `lubksb`
({{< code src/implicit/forward_sweep_impl.h ForwardSweep >}}). For $N=3$ it checks the factorisation with `ludcmp` and
keeps the explicit inverse ({{< code src/implicit/forward_sweep_impl.h ForwardSweep >}}). After every layer it checks that $\tilde{\mathsf C}_i$ and $\tilde{\boldsymbol\delta}_i$ are
finite. On any failure, `vic_fail_column` fills every $\boldsymbol\delta$ of the column with NaN and the sweep returns
({{< code src/implicit/vic_solve_failure.h vic_fail_column >}}). `vic_backward_substitute` skips a column whose first $\boldsymbol\delta$ is not
finite ({{< code src/implicit/vic_redistribute_impl.h vic_backward_substitute >}}). So a failed column is never partly back-substituted
(`[C3]`).

The dispatch `vic_solve_cpu` runs both passes per column ({{< code src/implicit/implicit_dispatch.cpp vic_solve_cpu >}}). Each layer depends on
every right-hand side below and above it (`[C4]`), so the column is serial; the parallelism is across columns.
On CUDA the sweep is one thread per column, and the assembly and the final cell update are one thread per cell.

: Code map of the block Thomas sweep. {#tbl-ch07-vic-sweep-code}

**How to use it.** The sweep has no key: it runs with every VIC (@sec-ch07-vic-options) and its only failure is the
refused column of @sec-ch07-vic-pivot and @sec-ch07-vic-reject. The elimination of the $N=3$ path is these lines
({{< code src/implicit/forward_sweep_impl.h ForwardSweep >}}):

```cpp
    a[i] -= b[i] * a[i - 1];
    ...
      if (ludcmp(A, indx) == 0) return vic_fail_column(delta, il, iu);
      a[i] = a[i].inverse().eval();
      delta[i] = a[i] * (rhs - b[i] * delta[i - 1]);
      a[i] = a[i] * c[i];
```

The first line forms $\mathsf A_i-\mathsf B_i\tilde{\mathsf C}_{i-1}$ in place; the last two are $\tilde{\boldsymbol\delta}_i$ and
$\tilde{\mathsf C}_i$ of @eq-ch07-vic-sweep, with `rhs` $=\mathbf f_i$. The back pass is
`delta[i] -= a[i] * delta[i + 1]` ({{< code src/implicit/vic_redistribute_impl.h vic_backward_substitute >}}).

check's port takes the right-hand side as given, so it covers the $N=3$ path with $\mathbf f^{\mathrm{tan}}_i=0$; the
subtraction itself is exercised by `vic_assembly_check.py` `[C7]` (@sec-ch07-vic-assembly). The
CPU and CUDA sweeps share the header; only the CPU path ran.

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
There is no pivoting between blocks. The sweep relies on the $\mathsf I/\Delta t_c$ diagonal and the upwind $\mathsf A^{\pm}$
to keep the eliminated blocks regular.
:::

1. **No accuracy test.** No ctest compares the sweep with a dense solve; the ctests check refusal and
   finiteness only.
2. **One rank per column.** The commented-out send and receive in the sweep are the trace of a distributed column
   that is not supported (@sec-ch07-vic-options).

<!-- reader glossary notes -->
[^rg-9741895ca2fa]: $\boldsymbol\delta_i$ — the implicit solve's unknown in cell $i$ (total mass, normal momentum, [tangential momenta], energy)
